six.name: xiPrime_zeros_in_open_critical_strip

theorem xiPrime_zeros_in_open_critical_strip :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, XiPrime.xiDeriv ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1

six.name: xiPrime_over_xi_re_pos
six.stmt:
theorem xiPrime_over_xi_re_pos :
    ∀ s : ℂ, 1 ≤ s.re → 0 < (XiPrime.xiDeriv s / XiPrime.xi s).re

six.name: xiPrime_simple_zeros_on_critical_line

theorem xiPrime_simple_zeros_on_critical_line :
    ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀,
      (0.85838 : ℝ) * (XiPrime.Ncount T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ (XiPrime.N0simple T (2 * T) : ℝ) ∧
      (0.92919 : ℝ) * (XiPrime.Ncount T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ (XiPrime.Ndist T (2 * T) : ℝ)

corpus.name: the geometric clause (perpendicular crossing)
corpus.text: **Perpendicular crossing.** At every simple zero ρ on the critical line, ξ'(ρ) is purely imaginary. The level curves of Re(ξ) and Im(ξ) cross at right angles. The crossing is not approximate — it is forced by Cauchy-Riemann at the reflection axis.
